meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用你现有的 Signal 号码收发消息:别人发来 Signal 消息会交给 Claude 处理,Claude 的回复也从该号码发出。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Signal 频道(例如「接入 Signal」「连上我的手机号」)时,技能开始执行关联流程;完成后,每次有 Signal 消息发到该号码,都会转给 Claude 处理。

say.text: 把 Signal 频道接进来,用我的手机号收发消息。
say.note: 会进入扫码关联设备的流程。

say.text: 设置好之后,我想在 Signal 里直接给你发消息。
say.note: 配置完成后 Signal 消息就会路由到 Claude。

say.text: 再加一个 Signal 群,群消息也交给同一个代理。
say.note: 先在该群发条消息,再接线即可。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a secondary device linked to your phone number over Signal, so it can send and receive Signal messages (DMs and groups). Incoming messages are handed to Claude; replies go out from that same number.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add Signal as a channel (e.g., connect my Signal), the setup flow starts. After linking, each new Signal message sent to the linked number or a group containing it is routed to Claude.

say_en.text: Add a Signal channel that sends and receives from my phone number.
say_en.note: Starts device-link and shows a QR to scan.

say_en.text: Set up Signal so I can chat with you from the Signal app.
say_en.note: After setup, Signal messages reach Claude.

say_en.text: Add a Signal group too, managed by the same agent.
say_en.note: Send a message in the group first, then wire it.
